2014_spells.power-word-pain-2.descriptio: You speak a word of power that causes waves of intense pain to assail one creature you can see within range. If the target has 100 hit points or fewer, it is subject to crippling pain. Otherwise, the spell has no effect on it.
2014_spells.power-word-pain-2.effectSumm: Change a target: it is subject to crippling pain
2014_spells.power-word-pain-2.fullDescri: Using 1 action, you speak a word of power that causes waves of intense pain to assail one creature you can see within range. If the target has 100 hit points or fewer, it is subject to crippling pain; Otherwise, the spell has no effect on it. The effect happens immediately and then ends.
